quote: Any cab, upon leaving any stand designated in accordance with the provisions of this Section, shall execute a right-hand turn, when a sign is posted giving notice of this requirement, at the first street intersection after it leaves such stand.

activation.condition: Cab leaves a stand designated under the referenced Section, with a posted sign giving notice of this requirement.

obligation.description: Execute a right-hand turn at the first street intersection after stand departure.

timing.description: At the first street intersection after leaving the qualifying stand.

parameter_refs.name: stand_departure_x_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original route x coordinate in metres for source-reviewed stand departure

parameter_refs.name: commanded_turn_path
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: right turn or straight-through engineering route at first junction
